evidence: UNVERIFIED: no source found describing Pantai Dorak (or Tanjung Kedabu) as a sand beach used for swimming; kelurahan profile says Selatpanjang Timur has no sea/beach - https://p2k.stekom.ac.id/ensiklopedia/Selat_Panjang_Timur,_Tebing_Tinggi,_Kepulauan_Meranti

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Solop (Pulau Cawan, Mandah) has white shell/coral sand but described as a muddy/swampy zone; no source on swimming - https://journal.unilak.ac.id/index.php/arsitektur/article/view/6476

Pantai Nanga To'i in Dompu: very calm sea water suitable for swimming or soaking (Lakey nearby has drownings/strong surf) - https://www.detik.com/bali/wisata/d-8278801/pantai-nanga-toi-surga-tersembunyi-di-dompu-dengan-latar-gunung-tambora

Pulau Derawan (Berau) has white-sand beaches and clear water; visitors snorkel and swim with turtles - https://www.indonesia.travel/id/id/destination/kalimantan/east-kalimantan/derawan-archipelago---eksotisme-kepulauan-derawan-surga-tersembunyi-yang-menawan

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Samudra Indah is in Sungai Raya Kepulauan, Bengkayang, but no source found on sand type or swimming - https://kalbar.antaranews.com/berita/446040/pemkab-bengkayang-luncurkan-paket-wisata-untuk-tingkatkan-kunjungan-wisatawan

UNVERIFIED: Akesahu is known for a freshwater hot-spring pool by the shore; no source on a sand sea beach for swimming - https://kumparan.com/kumparantravel/5-pantai-unik-di-indonesia-ada-yang-tawarkan-sensasi-berjalan-di-tengah-laut-1wNeWYSccPy
Pulau Beras Basah (Bontang) is a small white-sand island, a top pick for beach lovers and snorkeling - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/destinasi-wisata-bontang

Pulau Hoga (Kaledupa, Wakatobi) offers white-sand beaches and calm sea suited to relaxed snorkeling - https://www.indonesia.travel/id-id/travel-ideas/adventure/10-aktivitas-wajib-saat-berkunjung-ke-wakatobi-sulawesi-tenggara/

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Kolbano shore is coloured pebbles not sand; Pantai Oetune has sand dunes but no swimming info found - https://www.detik.com/bali/wisata/d-7435547/wisata-pantai-kolbano-di-ntt-lokasi-daya-tarik-hingga-rute

UNVERIFIED: swimming banned at Pantai Batakan Baru after crocodile sightings; Takisung is gently sloping with banana boats but no explicit swimming/sand evidence - https://www.jpnn.com/news/teror-buaya-di-pantai-bikin-wisatawan-waswas

UNVERIFIED: Galesong Utara coast has white sand and clear water rated suitable for recreation beach tourism, but no explicit swimming claim; Topejawa sand/swimming not documented - https://journal.ummat.ac.id/index.php/geography/article/view/20570
Pantai Walakiri: soft white sand and calm sea; visitors can swim in the calm sea - https://www.indonesia.travel/us-en/destination/bali-nusa-tenggara/east-nusa-tenggara/pantai-walakiri
Pantai Pero has fine white sand and clear blue sea suitable for swimming or playing in the water - https://rri.co.id/kupang/wisata/2450421/menikmati-keindahan-tersembunyi-pantai-pero-di-pulau-sumba

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Batu Lubang (Makbon, Kab. Sorong) has white sand, rocks and coral, but no swimming claim found; Tanjung Kasuari swimming is in Kota Sorong - https://ejournal.uin-suska.ac.id/index.php/jughrafia/article/view/37788

Pulau Larea-rea (Pulau Sembilan, Sinjai): activities include swimming, soaking, sunbathing and playing in the sand - https://www.detik.com/sulsel/wisata/d-6842177/ini-kegiatan-seru-yang-bisa-dilakukan-di-pulau-larea-rea-sinjai
UNVERIFIED: Pantai Gumumae listed as an SBT tourism spot, but no source on sand or swimming - https://m.jpnn.com/news/seram-bagian-timur-harap-investor-bantu-sektor-pariwisata

Temajuk (Paloh, Sambas): sloping white-sand beach, clear water suitable for swimming and diving, few rocks; Tanjung Batu itself is rocky cliff - https://rmol.id/politik/read/2016/02/28/237532/sambas-permata-tersembunyi-di-perbatasan-indonesia

Lagundri is a wide white-sand bay where people swim (caveat: strong surf; 7 students swept away while swimming in 2023) - https://www.inews.id/regional/sumut/7-siswa-sma-digulung-ombak-saat-berenang-di-pantai-lagundri-nisel-5-selamat-2-hilang/all
